basis: October 30, 2025 is the earliest qualifying disclosure I could verify. FET reported consolidated GAAP revenue of $196,231,000 for Q3 2025 versus $207,806,000 for Q3 2024, a 5.57% decline and $1,184,700 below the $197,415,700 cutoff. The August 8 Q3 forecast reached $200,000,000. The earliest date remains unresolved because the complete May 21 management remarks and the full September presentation as published could not be verified. The upper_bound below is the verified actual.

coverage.detail: February 20 Q4 2024 release. The $85–105 million outlook covered full-year 2025 adjusted EBITDA. It supplied no Q3 revenue ceiling.

May 1 Q1 release guided Q2 adjusted EBITDA to $18–22 million and annual free cash flow to $40–60 million. On May 2, management said revenue could begin falling in Q3 if commodity prices failed to rebound, without quantifying the decline. [Call transcript](https://www.roic.ai/quote/FET/transcripts/2025-year/1-quarter)

May 21 Water Tower fireside chat. FET’s May 19 notice identifies the CEO, CFO, date and webcast. The issuer-linked Zoom page was inaccessible. The host website yielded no readable event transcript or replay. [Zoom event](https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/8017473999850/WN_Cl0amNonSxqEckgJj50SrQ) · [Water Tower Research](https://watertowerresearch.com/)

TradingView independently lists a May 21 Status Update and event transcript, but its readable page exposes only the listing. Stock Analysis summarizes rig-count risk and an $85 million EBITDA scenario. Its full-transcript URL returned a cache miss, leaving the complete remarks unverified. [Event index](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/fet/transcripts/) · [Transcript attempt](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/fet/transcripts/348995-status-update/)

June 11 Sidoti presentation. The issuer deck identifies $193 million as Q1 revenue. The CEO’s public remarks repeat the conditional Q3 decline without a numeric ceiling. The issuer-linked host webcast was inaccessible. [Issuer event notice](https://ir.f-e-t.com/news-releases/news-release-details/forum-energy-technologies-present-sidoti-virtual-small-cap/) · [Sidoti webcast](https://sidoti.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_jEOADeu3TFixeVnzaVzbng) · [Remarks](https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/forum-energy-at-sidotis-conference-strategic-insights-and-growth-93CH-4091481)
August 7 Q2 release. The Q3 range of $19–23 million covered adjusted EBITDA. The $60–80 million range covered full-year free cash flow.

August 8 call. CFO Lyle Williams forecast $180–200 million of Q3 revenue. The high end exceeded the cutoff by $2,584,300. He separately forecast $760–800 million for full-year 2025. FET confirms the call date and announced a replay. Its Q2 reports listing provides the release and 10-Q. [Issuer call notice](https://ir.f-e-t.com/node/14586/pdf) · [Reports archive](https://ir.f-e-t.com/financial-information/reports)
August 18 issuer announcement concerned the NYSE Texas secondary listing and supplied no quarterly sales update.

September 18 Water Tower chat. The CFO’s approximately 5% decline compared Q3 industry activity with Q1 activity. His $85 million forecast covered full-year EBITDA. The public transcript supplied no revised Q3 sales ceiling. The issuer-linked Zoom page was inaccessible. [Public remarks](https://ng.investing.com/news/transcripts/forum-energy-at-water-tower-chat-strategic-growth-and-cash-flow-focus-93CH-2110286) · [Host webcast](https://us06web.zoom.us/webinar/register/2017575113620/WN_sntytto3SO-Kr-CF2ENr4w)
September 19 Form 8-K reported director Leslie Beyer’s retirement under Item 5.02. It furnished no presentation or revenue update.

Recovered the indexed issuer PDF titled Second Quarter 2025. Its forecast footnote explicitly assigns $760–800 million to 2025. Subtracting reported first-half revenue of $393,043,000 implies $366,957,000–406,957,000 for Q3 and Q4 combined. [First-half GAAP table](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1401257/000140125725000089/fet-20250630.htm)

PLS indexes 29 slides under September 29, document 110809. The prior review matched slides 3 and 15 to the issuer PDF. Fresh requests for those slides timed out, the full viewer was inaccessible, and the historical issuer snapshot was unavailable. The current IR page lists a 2026 presentation. The September posting date and complete version remain unverified. [Full viewer](https://www1.plsx.com/finder/viewer.aspx?doc=110809) · [Slide 3](https://www1.plsx.com/finder/viewer.aspx?bd=false&doc=110809&f=IsHistorical.1&q=&slide=3007050) · [Slide 15](https://www1.plsx.com/finder/viewer.aspx?bd=false&doc=110809&f=IsHistorical.1&q=&slide=3007062&v=1) · [Historical snapshot](https://web.archive.org/web/20250930/https://ir.f-e-t.com/events-and-presentations/presentations) · [Current IR page](https://ir.f-e-t.com/events-and-presentations/presentations)
October 6 notice scheduled the October 31 earnings call and said results would be released beforehand. It gave no preliminary revenue.

Reopened the issuer release and SEC Exhibit 99.1. Both show 196,231 and 207,806 in the same consolidated revenue row, in thousands of dollars, for the three months ended September 30, 2025 and 2024. The headline’s 2% decrease uses the sequential comparator of $199,764,000.

publication_date_evidence: The issuer release is dated October 30, 2025. Item 2.02 of the October 31 Form 8-K expressly confirms that FET issued the Q3 results on October 30. This establishes the public date of the actuals. [Form 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1401257/000140125725000106/fet-20251030.htm)
